  <div class="paper-meta">
    <span>2025.07</span>
    <span>Prompt Optimization</span>
  </div>
  <h3>GEPA: Reflective Prompt Evolution Can Outperform Reinforcement Learning</h3>
  <p>GEPA introduces a prompt optimizer that uses natural language reflection to learn high-level rules from trial and error, outperforming GRPO by 6% on average with up to 35x fewer rollouts. It also beats MIPROv2 by over 10% and shows promising results as an inference-time search strategy for code optimization.</p>
  <div class="paper-links">

  <div class="paper-grid">
<article class="paper-card" id="becoming-experienced-judges-selective-test-time-learning-for-evaluators">
  <div class="paper-meta">
    <span>2025.12</span>
    <span>Judge Prompting</span>
  </div>
  <h3>Becoming Experienced Judges: Selective Test-Time Learning for Evaluators</h3>
  <p>This paper introduces Learning While Evaluating (LWE), enabling LLM-as-a-judge systems to improve sequentially at inference time by updating an evolving meta-prompt with self-generated feedback. It further proposes Selective LWE, which updates only on self-inconsistent cases to improve evaluation quality with better cost efficiency.</p>
  <div class="paper-links">
<a class="resource-link" href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.06751" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><img src="../../assets/icons/arxiv.svg" alt="" aria-hidden="true" />Paper</a>
  </div>
</article>
<article class="paper-card" id="auto-prompt-ensemble-for-llm-judge">
  <div class="paper-meta">
    <span>2025.10</span>
    <span>Judge Prompting</span>
  </div>
  <h3>Auto-Prompt Ensemble for LLM Judge</h3>
  <p>APE improves LLM-as-a-judge reliability by automatically discovering auxiliary evaluation dimensions from failure cases and ensembling them with confidence-aware selection. It boosts agreement with human-aligned benchmarks by using test-time computation more effectively.</p>
  <div class="paper-links">
<a class="resource-link" href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.06538" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><img src="../../assets/icons/arxiv.svg" alt="" aria-hidden="true" />Paper</a>
